name: Can I install a glass shower door myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a glass shower door myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a glass shower door, especially a frameless one, requires precision, specialized tools, and knowledge of handling heavy glass panels safely. DIY installation can lead to alignment issues, leaks, or even damage to the glass or your bathroom. Hiring a professional service like Hometelligent Inc. ensures that the door is installed correctly, securely, and in compliance with safety standards, providing peace of mind and protecting your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional installation is recommended for glass shower doors due to the precision, specialized tools, and safety required to avoid damage or leaks.
